generation.generator: privileged designer expert controller; not a human teleoperation claim

indexing: Zero-based half-open command slices [start,end); row i is measured after command i. Time intervals include the preceding measured state; final control step can be truncated by success.

high_level_plan.goal: 双手抬起并建立翻转净空

low_level_plan.action: 稳定抬起且分开的双手
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 盘由桌面支撑；双手先稳定

low_level_plan.action: 拇指从上方接近远侧盘沿
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 接近阶段避免提前碰盘

low_level_plan.action: 在远侧盘沿外降低拇指
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 沿盘外侧下降，保留桌面支撑

low_level_plan.action: 低速建立拇指推盘接触
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 以测得接触建立推力，限制速度与受力

low_level_plan.action: 沿桌面轻推至近侧桌沿
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 按实测悬伸量停止，盘心仍在支撑侧

low_level_plan.action: 卸掉原推盘拇指的载荷
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 先卸力，再撤离；桌面继续承载

low_level_plan.action: 撤开推盘拇指
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 从盘沿退出，避免带动圆盘

low_level_plan.action: 双手撤至盘上方和侧方
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 为改变手型预留几何空间

low_level_plan.action: 调整腕部姿态以双手接近
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 局部 IK 使用关节范围和腕部间隙约束

low_level_plan.action: 预张开并调整空载手指
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 空载预整形后再建立盘面接触

low_level_plan.action: 分别闭合两手的拇指与下侧手指
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 每只手建立两盘面的独立夹持；按接触力臂分配载荷

low_level_plan.action: 保持双手夹持共同抬盘
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 保持双手支撑；夹持丢失不得超过 0.1 s；建立旋转净空

low_level_plan.action: 同步旋转两手以翻转圆盘
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 双手夹持，腕部间隙、姿态和切向载荷反馈；保留全局限值

low_level_plan.action: 接近翻面完成时改用实测压力反馈
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 仅在已接近反面朝上且双手夹持有效时触发；原物理约束不变

low_level_plan.action: 翻面后先稳定双手夹持
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 蓝面朝上，准备受控支撑交接

low_level_plan.action: 将载荷移交右手夹持并释放左手
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 此交接只发生在双手翻面完成后；保持圆盘受支撑

low_level_plan.action: 移开左手并准备再次推盘
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 右手承载，左手从盘体附近移开

low_level_plan.action: 右手将反面朝上的盘移至桌沿外侧
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 保持姿态与右手支撑，避免下侧手指被桌沿夹住

low_level_plan.action: 在桌沿外降低右手及圆盘
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 盘与承载手在桌沿外下降

low_level_plan.action: 对齐圆盘与桌面高度
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 按测量高度调整，继续由右手支撑

low_level_plan.action: 左手拇指从上方接近近侧盘沿
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 右手承载期间保持推盘手净空

low_level_plan.action: 在近侧盘沿外降低左手拇指
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 沿盘外侧下降至推盘高度

low_level_plan.action: 建立左手拇指与盘沿的轻柔接触
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 右手继续承载，左手低速寻找接触

low_level_plan.action: 将圆盘从承载手推向桌面
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 逐渐建立桌面支撑并打开右拇指；控制合力和姿态

low_level_plan.action: 核对桌面与下侧指垫共同承载
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 明确记录支撑交接控制步，不将它省略成瞬时跳转

low_level_plan.action: 盘心获得桌面支撑后撤出下侧指垫并继续推盘
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 撤指时暂停推进；左拇指维持桌面盘沿高度，避免撬起圆盘

low_level_plan.action: 卸去左拇指推力并松手稳定
low_level_plan.local_constraint: 完整位于桌内、蓝面朝上、目标内、无机器人接触并静止两秒

robot_self_contact_observations_50hz.scope: control-boundary observations only; not substep collision certification

robot_environment_contact_observations_5.scope: control-boundary observations only; not substep collision certification

balance_scope: Pelvis fixed by declared model; object support/contact is evaluated. No free-standing balance certificate.
collision_scope: Native collision geometry and local IK clearance plus 50 Hz contact observations; observed robot contacts are retained. No claim of zero contact or substep whole-body collision-free certification.
local_constraint_scope: Local constraint text describes the expert generator's intent. Measured states, segment peaks, whole-run physical/actuator checks and contact audits provide the stated evidence; not every prose intent has a separate formal checker.
video_scope: 10 fps independent replay for review; sub-100ms segments require command indices and the 50 Hz measured trace, not visual frame separation.
